Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: In the final step (Step 3), the Planner incorrectly deduced that Da Nang is in the Mekong Delta region. Da Nang is actually the capital of the South Central Coast region (Tây Nguyên is Central Highlands, Đông Nam Bộ is Southeast, but Da Nang is specifically South Central Coast). The Planner failed to verify the geographical region of Da Nang, leading to the wrong conclusion that both locations are in the Mekong Delta.
